name: 菲斯
summary:
由Polytron团队开发、曾获得GDC 2012（游戏开发者大会）最佳独立游戏奖项的《Fez》是一款极具创意的利用视角的转换来改变关卡舞台，结合2D和3D的关卡的平台动作游戏全面展现游戏清新画面、复古音效背后创意玩法所能能给玩家带来的无限乐趣。

FEZ is a game developed by POLYTRON. In it, you play as Gomez, a 2D creature living in what he believes is a 2D world.
Until a strange and powerful artifact reveals to him the existence of a mysterious third dimension!

FEZ is a videogame developed by Polytron Corporation, available on Xbox Live Arcade, PC Mac Linux via Steam, Humble and GOG, and on PS3, PS4 and PS Vita.
